data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [weak customer service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/66db134c014c5760e1b473be)
Like many people on here, I'm very frustrated with the lack of communication from customer service. I'm trying to understand when my rug will ship since i've gotten no info about that, and I'm trying to get in touch to change the shipping address since the rug mat went to my old address. But I'm having a hard time even getting them to email me back, which seems like a very inefficient process.

September 6, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Sep 6, 2024

Hi there,

Thank you so much for your feedback and patience. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced. We’ve escalated your request, and our customer experience team will be in touch shortly to provide you with the shipping details and assist with changing the shipping address.

Please let us know if you have any further questions in the meantime. We appreciate your understanding.
